member.name: T:Milvaion.Domain.JsonModels.AppSettingsDocument
member.summary:
The application's runtime-tunable settings, stored as a single jsonb document.
Sectioned: each feature owns a section, so the document grows over time. Because the column is jsonb and Npgsql (de)serializes the whole object, adding a field here never requires a database migration.
Do NOT put here: - bootstrap-critical values (DB / Redis / RabbitMQ connection strings) - the app needs those before it can read this row, so they stay in appsettings; - secrets (SMTP passwords, webhook URLs) - this document is surfaced to the settings UI; - binary assets (logo, favicon) - those stay static, served from files.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.JsonModels.AppSettingsDocument.Branding
member.summary: Branding text shown in the browser tab, sidebar and login page. The logo and favicon are intentionally not here - they are static files and not runtime-configurable.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.JsonModels.AppSettingsDocument.Notifications
member.summary: Per-notification routing and on/off, managed at runtime. Mirrors the appsettings alerting config but lives here so channels and enablement can be switched without a restart. Seeded from appsettings on first run. Channel availability itself (whether Slack/Email/... are configured) stays in appsettings and is display-only.

member.name: T:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey
member.summary: Entity of the MilvaionApiKeys table. Represents a non-interactive credential used by external clients (CI pipelines, MCP clients, integrations) to authenticate against the Milvaion API.
member.remarks: The key itself is never persisted. The issued token is a signed JWT whose jti claim carries this entity's id, so authentication is a signature check followed by a lookup of this record. That lookup is what makes revocation, expiry and last-used tracking possible.

member.summary: Optional description explaining what this key is used for.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey.MaskedKey
member.summary: Last characters of the issued key, kept only so a user can match a listed key against the one stored in their configuration. Never contains enough of the key to be usable.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey.KeyVersion
member.summary: Version of the signing secret this key was issued with. Allows the signing secret to be rotated without invalidating every key at once.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey.ExpiresAt
member.summary: UTC expiry of the key. Null means the key does not expire.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey.RevokedAt
member.summary: UTC time at which the key was revoked. Null means the key is still active. A revoked key is rejected even though its signature is still valid.

member.name: P:Milvaion.Domain.MilvaionApiKey.LastUsedAt
member.summary: UTC time the key was last used to authenticate a request. Useful for spotting keys that can safely be removed.
